replies.text: Correct, those are the only two on Earth. Liechtenstein is surrounded by Switzerland and Austria, both landlocked, and Uzbekistan by Afghanistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Turkmenistan, all landlocked. Uzbekistan only became doubly landlocked in 1991, because before that its neighbour was the Soviet Union, which had a coast.
